classes.summary: Defaults stick through three channels: effort, endorsement and reference points. Automatic enrollment raised participation, but a low default rate can anchor savings.
Interaction terms let one predictor's effect depend on another; centering makes the main effects readable; a fanning residual plot means non-constant variance.
Resizing an open-addressing table rehashes every key; tombstones count as occupied when deciding to resize; benchmark only the operation you measure.
